title: The sandbox image's PID 1 never reaps orphans, so killed processes stay zombies
description: Filed from ticfac (xte findings c315f3f4, fc286c57, 2026-09-23). In the factory sandbox image PID 1 is the Node control server, which does not reap orphaned children. Every process killed there - a timed-out gate's child, a cancelled harness's subprocesses - stays a zombie forever, and ticfac's container tests read a zombie as a live process (its gate-timeout test, ticfac 58z). Run an init that reaps (tini, or the control server's own reaper) as PID 1.
acceptance_criteria: A process orphaned and killed inside the sandbox is reaped; a test inside the image proves no zombie remains
